description: Median, middle half and range per comparable unit (per hour of video or audio, per image, per task, per company, per title, and more) for each kind of AI training data and each side of the market, computed from published prices. Without `kind`, returns every rate the evidence supports a median for.

kind.description: The kind of data: company (Company records), code (Source code), video (Video and footage), audio (Audio and speech), images (Images), text (Text and archives), environment (Datasets, tasks and environments), physical (Physical-world data), people (Work by people), products (Data products).

side.description: The side of the market: pay (Paid to the people who make it), offer (Offered to holders), licence (Sales that happened), listing (Asking prices off the shelf), collection (Made to order), cost (Cost to produce).

name: get_market_rates
title: Market rates for AI training data
